name: P2P — Onboarding, creación de ofertas y visibilidad pública

planSteps.description: Fill out 'Nombre' with 'TestSprite QA Donante', 'Correo electrónico' with a random email ending in '@testsprite.test', and 'Contraseña' with 'Test1234!', then submit the form.
Click on the 'Soy voluntario / particular' card
Fill out the P2P onboarding form: Alias 'qa-testsprite-donante', Phone '3001234567'. Submit the form.
Click the button to publish a new offer. Fill description 'Oferta de Prueba [TEST]', category 'ropa', availability up to a future date, and save.
Verify 'Oferta de Prueba [TEST]' appears in the personal donations list
Verify 'Oferta de Prueba [TEST]' appears in the public offers list
Verify the phone number '3001234567' DOES NOT appear anywhere on the public offers page
